rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you for your offer to help! I've been thinking about what would be most valuable, and I think I have a concrete answer. I've developed an AI Preparedness Assessment framework—a practical tool for organizations to evaluate their readiness for AI advancement. I'm recruiting 15 pilot organizations to test it over the next 2-3 months, and this is where your data analyst skills would be incredibly valuable. **What I need most:** 1. **Structured feedback analysis**: As pilot organizations complete assessments, I need someone to systematically analyze: - Which questions are unclear or misinterpreted - Which dimensions are hardest to assess - Patterns in what organizations struggle with - Gaps in the framework 2. **Maturity level validation**: The framework has 0-4 maturity scales for each dimension. I need help: - Checking if the levels are actually distinct and meaningful - Seeing if organizations can reliably self-assess - Identifying if certain industries cluster at certain levels 3. **Simple metrics dashboard**: Track pilot progress and early adoption (nothing fancy, maybe a simple spreadsheet/dashboard) **Time estimate**: About 3-5 hours/week for 8-12 weeks during the pilot phase (flexible timing) **What you'd get**: - First look at all pilot data - Co-authorship on any case studies or analysis we publish - Real insight into how organizations think about AI preparedness - Connection to the pilot organizations if you're interested The framework is live at halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app and the code is on GitHub (repo just went public today). Does this sound interesting? Happy to discuss more details or adjust the scope. Best, Morgan --- Halcyon Threshold morgan@halcyonthreshold.org halcyonthreshold.org"
rows.quote: Volunteer recruited:** Priya Raman (data analyst, 5 hrs/week)

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Idris Bellamy <grants@emberfallfund.org> with subject "Rapid Grant Application: AI Preparedness Assessment". It read: "Hi Idris, Following up from the meetup last week—I'm submitting an application for the rapid grants round. **Project**: AI Preparedness Assessment framework and pilot testing **Amount**: $18,000 **Duration**: 6 months I've attached the full proposal below. The short version: I'm developing a practical framework to help organizations prepare for AI advancement—something I've identified as significantly neglected despite being high-impact. The framework is already built (v1.0), and funding would support pilot testing with 15 organizations, refinement, and public release. This addresses the \"what's neglected\" question I posed at the meetup. After analysis, organizational preparedness for the AI transition period emerged as the clearest gap—neither theoretical enough for academia nor immediate enough for policy, but critically important. Full proposal follows. Happy to discuss or provide additional information. Thanks for considering this. Best, Morgan --- [Full proposal text below] # Emberfall Fund Rapid Grant Proposal ## Halcyon Threshold: AI Preparedness Assessment & Tools **Applicant**: Morgan Hale, Founder, Halcyon Threshold **Contact**: morgan@halcyonthreshold.org **Amount Requested**: $18,000 **Duration**: 6 months (December 2026 - May 2027) --- ## Executive Summary Halcyon Threshold requests $18,000 to develop, test, and distribute the AI Preparedness Assessment (APA)—a practical framework helping organizations navigate AI's rapid advancement. This addresses a critical gap: most organizations lack any systematic way to prepare for AI acceleration beyond ad-hoc adoption of current tools. **Key Deliverables**: - Refined, tested APA framework (v2.0) - Implementation resources (templates, case studies, worksheets) - 15 pilot organizations completing the assessment - Public website and documentation - Open-source release and community building **Impact**: Better organizational preparedness creates compounding benefits—better decisions, earlier identification of risks, more thoughtful AI deployment, and improved coordination across sectors. --- ## What We'll Do ### Phase 1: Framework Refinement (Months 1-2) **Activities**: Recruit 15 pilot organizations across sectors, facilitate assessments, gather feedback, refine framework, develop sector-specific adaptations, create templates **Deliverable**: APA v2.0 with implementation toolkit ### Phase 2: Resource Development (Months 2-4) **Activities**: Implementation guide, anonymized case studies, online assessment tool, video walkthroughs, sector guides, FAQ **Deliverable**: Comprehensive resource library ### Phase 3: Public Release & Distribution (Months 4-6) **Activities**: Launch website, release under CC BY 4.0, present at conferences, publish in AI safety forums, outreach to sectors, establish support mechanism **Deliverable**: Publicly available, actively used framework --- ## Why Me / Why This ### Why Morgan Hale - Practical orientation and systems thinking background - Strong writing and communication skills - Networks in AI safety and various sectors - Dedicated time (evenings/weekends + 1 day/week) - Resource-efficient approach I'm not claiming deep AI safety research credentials—this project doesn't need that. It needs practical tool-building, real-world testing, and clear communication. ### Why This is Neglected Not theoretical enough for academia, not immediate enough for policy, not technical enough for ML safety. Result: thousands of organizations will make consequential AI decisions with no framework. ### Why This Works Concrete and actionable, scalable across organization sizes, open source for compounding impact, early intervention prevents problems, creates cross-sector standards. ### Evidence of Traction - Framework v1.0 complete (see halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app) - 15+ organizations interested in piloting - Volunteer support recruited - Infrastructure ready --- ## Budget: $18,000 | Category | Amount | Justification | |----------|--------|---------------| | Personnel (Morgan) | $12,000 | 240 hours @ $50/hr. Framework development, pilot facilitation, resource creation, outreach | | Pilot Organization Support | $2,000 | Stipends for 15 pilots ($100-150 each) to ensure commitment | | Tools & Infrastructure | $1,500 | Website hosting, assessment tool, video equipment, software | | Travel & Conferences | $1,500 | 3 conference presentations | | Consulting/Expertise | $1,000 | Sector specialists, UX design, copy editing | **Funding Match**: $2,000 personal funds + ~100 volunteer hours --- ## Success Metrics (6 months) **Quantitative**: - 15 organizations complete full assessment - 40+ organizations use framework independently - 10+ implement at least 3 recommendations - 5+ conference presentations - 3+ other groups adapt framework - 100+ people engaged via office hours **Qualitative**: - Organizations report better AI decision-making - Framework rated as clear and useful - Other efforts reference or build on APA - Case studies produce generalizable insights --- ## Risks & Mitigations **Risk**: Organizations don't find it useful → *Pilot testing before public release* **Risk**: Too ambitious for timeline → *Phased approach, clear MVP* **Risk**: Gets scooped → *Open source means scooping = success* **Risk**: AI changes too fast → *Capability-agnostic design, quarterly updates* --- ## Sustainability If valuable: volunteer community, consulting revenue, follow-on grants, partnerships If not: publish lessons learned, release all materials, redirect to what works --- ## Current Status - Research analysis: Complete - Framework v1.0: Complete and public - Website: Live at halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app - Repository: Public on GitHub - Community interest: Strong --- **Contact**: morgan@halcyonthreshold.org **Website**: halcyonthreshold.org **Live Framework**: halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app This isn't the most glamorous AI safety project, but it might be one of the most useful. Thank you for considering this proposal. Happy to discuss furth…"
rows.quote: Grant proposal submitted:** Emberfall Fund rapid grant application for $18,000
